user.title: Measurements
user.description: From the hourly statistics of these sensors the integration learns how your building responds to supply and outdoor temperature. With a few days of history the model is ready right away.

data_description.room_sensors: Preselected are all room thermostats. Each room is controlled towards the set point of its thermostat; rooms that are switched off (set point below 10 °C) are ignored. Remove the rooms this heating circuit does not heat. Rooms with only a thermometer use the set point for rooms without thermostat.
data_description.supply_sensor: The measured supply temperature of the floor heating circuit after the mixing valve.
data_description.outdoor_sensor: A reliable outdoor temperature, ideally the mean or median of several sensors.
data_description.weather_entity: Only weather services with an hourly forecast are offered. Without a forecast the controller keeps the current outdoor temperature.
data_description.price_sensor: Sensors with a price per kWh or MWh are offered. The sensor must provide the prices of the coming hours in an attribute, like the [EPEX Spot integration](https://github.com/mampfes/ha_epex_spot). Nord Pool and Tibber formats are recognised as well.

control.title: Set point handover

data_description.control_mode: "Create a new set point sensor": the integration creates the sensor "Supply set point output" itself, nothing has to be set up beforehand. Your heating controller reads it, e.g. with an ESPHome sensor of type homeassistant. While control is switched off the sensor is unavailable and the heating keeps its own heating curve.

control.description: Choose how the calculated supply set point is handed to your heating. After setup, control is switched off: the set point is only calculated and shown. It is handed over once you turn on the switch "Control active".

target_climate.title: Climate entity
target_climate.description: Choose the climate entity of the supply controller. Its target temperature is set to the calculated supply set point every hour.

target_number.title: Number entity
target_number.description: Choose the number or input_number entity that takes the supply set point. It is set every hour.

error.rooms_required: Choose at least one room sensor.

data_description.enable_entity: Not needed to switch control on, that is what the switch "Control active" is for. Pick an entity here to pause control automatically, e.g. the operating mode of the heating: "off" or "cool" pauses, "heat" controls.
data_description.horizon: How many hours the controller plans ahead. Should be well above the reaction time of the floor.
data_description.train_days: How many days of statistics the model learns from. It is recalculated every night.
